feed_title: Memory Foam Bolster Dog Sofa Bed, Three Bolsters, Open Front, Medium 80 x 60cm to XXL 135 x 100cm | PawLunova Grasmere
descriptionHtml:
Memory foam base. Bolsters on three sides. A seat of their own.

Grasmere is a memory foam bolster dog sofa bed with an open front, in four sizes from Medium 80 × 60cm to XXL 135 × 100cm.

By nine the negotiation begins. They lie on the rug, sigh, get up, and try their luck on your sofa again. What they want is the seat, the armrest, the company.

Grasmere hands over all three. Memory foam holds its shape under a heavy dog instead of packing down, and the open fourth side makes getting on a step.

What they get

  • A memory foam base: The foam forms the seat and does not shift out from under them.
  • Bolsters on three sides: A chin, a back or a sideways flop gets something solid.
  • An open fourth side: Nothing to climb over.
  • A full-zip removable cover: It all comes off, following the sewn-in care label.
  • Four sizes up to 135 × 100cm: Room for a giant breed.

Best for: Sofa-claimers, big dogs who sleep stretched, and evenings where everyone wants a seat.

Why it is worth the money

£119 for the Medium, £149 for the XXL. That buys memory foam rather than loose filling, three bolsters and a full-zip cover. The foam core carries a 5-year no-flatten guarantee, and over those 1825 nights the Medium is about 7p a night and the XXL 8p.

One thing first. The XXL is furniture. At 135 × 100cm it takes the floor space of an armchair, which owners underestimate.

Size and fit

SizeOutside (cm)
Medium80 × 60
Large100 × 75
XL120 × 90
XXL135 × 100

Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. These are outside measurements and the bolsters take some of it. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly which one fits.

Everyday care

Unzip the cover and wash it following the sewn-in care label. Air-dry before refitting. Never soak the foam.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide. 5 years on the foam.

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. The foam core also has a 5-year no-flatten guarantee under normal domestic use, subject to the guarantee terms; cover wear and pet damage are not included. Read the full returns and guarantee terms. This guarantee is in addition to your statutory rights and does not affect them.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.

The questions we get asked most.

How do I know which size to get?

Nose to tail base, plus 15 to 20cm. Between sizes, size up.

How much is delivery, and how quickly does it arrive?

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Timings show at the basket.

Can I pay in instalments?

Yes. Instalment plans are shown on the checkout page.

What does the 5-year no-flatten guarantee actually cover?

The foam core, under normal use. Cover wear and pet damage are excluded.

Will it suit an older dog who finds it hard to get up?

We describe the bed, not your dog. Memory foam base, open front, no side to climb. Ask your vet.

Can I actually wash it?

Yes. The full zip takes the cover off. The foam stays dry.

What if my dog just won't use it?

Then it goes back inside 100 nights. Free collection, full refund.

Choose their size and give them a memory foam seat of their own.
